subject: Finalize hire decision: Alexis Monroe
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Reed <olivia.reed@recruitly.co>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Finalize hire decision: Alexis Monroe

Folks —

Thanks for interviewing Alexis last week. We need to close this loop so recruiting can move forward with either an offer or a no-go. Short ask: please submit your final numeric score and 1–2 line justification in the scorecard (attached) by EOD Tuesday (PST). I will compile and call the closure on Wed morning if there are no outstanding questions.

Context / process notes:
- Role: Staff ML Engineer (platform infra)
- Hiring manager: Marissa (she's leaning hire if technical concerns can be mitigated)
- Quick rubric: problem solving (30%), system design (30%), coding (20%), communication/team fit (20%)

If we end up 50/50 I am asking Logan to act as tiebreaker (Logan: can you confirm availability Wed morning?).

Attachments: candidate-AlexisMonroe-20270919-scorecard.csv (please update), zoom-recording-Alexis-interview-20270918.mp4 (internal only), and I will post a brief panel summary after I collect votes.

Thanks — short and concrete please.

Irene Choi
Recruiting Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalize hire decision: Alexis Monroe

Submitted my scorecard — overall 8/10 (hire).
Short notes: strong coding and product sense; system design felt a bit surface-level for Staff but I think the gap is coachable given their deep infra experience. No blockers from my side.

Attached: aditya-alexis-scorecard-20270919.csv

– Aditya

Senior Engineering Manager
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalize hire decision: Alexis Monroe

I uploaded my scorecard this morning — overall 6/10 (do not hire).
Quick rationale: Alexis is excellent operationally and has strong infra domain experience, but on the system design portion they missed multi-tenant isolation tradeoffs and hadn't anticipated a few scaling failure modes I expect for a Staff hire. My recommendation would be to keep in candidate pool for senior-level (IC4) roles, but not Staff (IC5) at this time.

If the group wants to pursue hire contingent on a targeted technical coaching plan, I can document specific gaps.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Engineering Manager, Core Infra
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Sep 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalize hire decision: Alexis Monroe

Irene — thanks for coordinating. I uploaded my scorecard: 9/10 (hire).
Notes: Alexis showed the right systems intuition in the coding + infra sections and has strong cross-team collaboration examples. I agree there are some system-design edge cases we flagged, but they are addressable in a short onboarding plan and with a senior mentor. I would like us to move to offer pending a quick reference check (one technical ref).

If Logan is comfortable tying the decision, I nominate the following offer band: $220–240k base, equity 0.20–0.30%. Olivia (recruiter) — please standby for offer packet prep if we greenlight. I attached a one-page panel summary and the suggested compensation band.

Marissa Cole
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Logan — thanks in advance for doing the tiebreak. Current tally from submitted scorecards:
- Marissa: hire (9)
- Aditya: hire (8)
- Tessa: do not hire (6)

If you cast as hire, we'll proceed with offer (Marissa to finalize band and Olivia to run references / GH). If you cast do-not-hire, we'll close as no-go and I will notify Alexis with constructive feedback.

Please reply with your vote and one-line rationale by EOD today. If no reply, I'll treat this as a neutral abstain and escalate to hiring committee on Thu morning.

Action items summary:
- Logan: tiebreak vote (EOD Tue)
- Marissa: prepare offer packet and confirm final band if Logan votes hire
- Olivia (recruiter): standby to run one technical reference and draft offer
- Irene: draft candidate feedback if no-go

Attachments: panel-summary-AlexisMonroe-20270920.pdf (panel brief), candidate-AlexisMonroe-20270919-scorecard.csv

Thanks everyone — short replies welcome.

Irene Choi
